preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of the string s.

postconditions.description: The length of the reduced string is less than or equal to the length of the original string.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] != result[i+1] for i in range(len(result) - 1))
postconditions.description: The reduced string contains no consecutive identical characters.
The result is a valid string that can be constructed from the characters of the original string after applying the operation any number of times.
